checks.source: Al-Ghamdi BS, Fagir N, Alnahdi F, Alhamami A, Baali M, Alghamdi S, Alruwaili N, De Vol E (2024). Yield of Tilt Table Test in Diagnosing Syncope in Patients With Suspected Neurally Mediated Syncope. Cardiology Research.

source_fit_rows.source_population: 426 patients aged 7-84 years (mean 38.4 years) referred for tilt-table testing of suspected neurally mediated syncope at a tertiary heart center in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
source_fit_rows.family_population: US colloquial English parent describing a 14-year-old daughter with recurrent brief orthostatic dizzy spells during warm school assemblies
source_fit_rows.note: Cohort spans ages 7-84 years (including adolescents) with suspected neurally mediated syncope/presyncope and reports 'dizzy spells' verbatim, but comes from an English-language cardiology report in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia rather than a US parent/adolescent setting (US colloquial label comes from Wiktionary in dialect_lexicon_20261109.json).

concerns.text: Family equity_dimension is 'us_colloquial_parent_carer' (matching Wiktionary's 'colloquial, US' label for 'spell' in dialect_lexicon_20261109.json), while the cited PubMed symptom source (PMID 39698010) is an English-language tilt-table cohort aged 7-84 years from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
